passages.heading: MD&A
passages.text: The following discussion and analysis of Roivant’s financial condition and results of operations should be read in conjunction with Roivant’s consolidated financial statements and notes to those statements included elsewhere in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. Certain information contained in the discussion and analysis set forth below includes forward-looking statements that involve risks and uncertainties. Roivant’s actual results may differ materially from those anticipated in these forward-looking statements as a result of many factors. Please see “Forward-Looking Statements” and “Risk Factors” in this Annual Report on Form 10-K. Our fiscal year ends on March 31 and our fiscal quarters end on June 30, September 30 and December 31. Overview Roivant is a biopharmaceutical company that aims to improve the lives of patients by accelerating the development and commercialization of medicines that matter. Roivant’s pipeline includes brepocitinib, a potent small molecule inhibitor of JAK1 and TYK2 currently under review at the FDA for the treatment of dermatomyositis and also in late stage development for the treatment of non-infectious uveitis, cutaneous sarcoidosis and lichen planopilaris; IMVT-1402, a fully human monoclonal antibody targeting FcRn in development across several IgG-mediated autoimmune indications; and mosliciguat, an inhaled sGC activator in development for pulmonary hypertension associated with interstitial lung disease. We advance our pipeline by creating nimble subsidiaries or “Vants” to develop and commercialize our medicines and technologies. Beyond therapeutics, Roivant also incubates discovery-stage companies and health technology startups complementary to its biopharmaceutical business. Components of Results of Operations Revenue Revenue primarily relates to amounts earned in connection with license agreements, as well as revenue generated by subscription and service-based fees. Cost of revenues Our cost of revenues primarily relates to subscription and service-based revenue recognized for the use of technology developed and consists primarily of employee, hosting and third-party data costs. Research and development expenses Research and development expenses consist mainly of costs incurred in connection with the discovery and development of our product candidates. passages.heading: Risk factors
passages.text: Our business involves a high degree of risk. You should carefully consider the risks described below, together with the other information contained in this Annual Report on Form 10-K, including the section entitled “Management’s Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition and Results of Operations” and our audited consolidated financial statements and the related notes, as well as the risks, uncertainties and other information set forth in the reports and other materials filed or furnished by us and our majority-controlled subsidiary, Immunovant, Inc. (“Immunovant”), with the SEC. We cannot assure you that any of the events discussed in the risk factors below will not occur. These risks could have a material and adverse impact on our business, prospects, results of operations, financial condition and cash flows. If any 56 Table of Contents such events were to happen, the trading shares of our common shares could decline, and you could lose all or part of your investment. Unless the context otherwise requires, references in this section to “we,” “us,” “our,” “Roivant” and the “Company” refer to Roivant Sciences Ltd. and its subsidiaries and affiliates. References to our “product candidates” include our current product candidates and any future products or product candidates. Approval from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (“FDA”) or other applicable international regulatory authority is required before a product or product candidate may be marketed and sold in the relevant jurisdiction. Risks Related to Our Business and Industry Risks Related to Our Strategy and Financial Position Our relatively limited operating history and the inherent uncertainties and risks involved in biopharmaceutical product development and commercialization may make it difficult for us to execute on our business model and for you to assess our future prospects. We are a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical and healthcare technology company with a relatively limited operating history upon which you can evaluate our business and prospects. We were formed in April 2014, and our operations to date have primarily been limited to acquiring or in-licensing product candidates, pursuing the clinical development and commercialization of those product candidates, managing and operating our subsidiaries, which we refer to as “Vants,” financing activities, efforts to discover new product candidates, the creation or acquisition of healthcare technology companies and products and efforts to enforce and defend our intellectual property. We do not currently have any commercial stage products and we do not expect to generate product revenues from the commercial sale of our product candidates until we receive applicable regulatory approvals for one of our product candidates. Drug development and commercialization is a challenging and inherently uncertain undertaking that involves significant upfront investments and a substantial degree of risk. If we do not successfully address and manage these risks, our business and prospects will suffer. credit_strengths.text: Roivant holds a substantial unrestricted cash balance that dwarfs its current liabilities, and the resulting current ratio sits far above the health care sector median, indicating ample near-term liquidity to fund clinical programs without external financing.

The capital structure appears essentially unlevered, with no funded debt tagged and cash interest paid reported at nil, so the company carries no meaningful fixed charge burden and retains flexibility to raise non-dilutive capital if pipeline milestones justify it.

key_risks.text: Roivant remains a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company with no commercial-stage products and no expectation of product revenue until regulatory approvals are obtained, so operating losses and cash consumption are likely to persist well beyond the current fiscal year.

Operating cash outflow and free cash flow are deeply negative, and with no debt tags reported the absence of a debt maturity schedule and interest expense line limits visibility on any off-balance-sheet or lease-like obligations that could compete with pipeline funding.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: With cash interest paid reported at nil and no funded debt outstanding, conventional coverage and leverage ratios are not meaningful; debt servicing capacity instead rests on the liquidity runway provided by the large cash balance relative to the annual cash burn.

Free cash flow is negative and absorbs cash reserves, but the current ratio and cash position provide a multi-year cushion at the current burn rate; any acceleration in research and development spending would shorten that runway and increase refinancing or equity-raise dependence.

overall_credit_view.text: Roivant presents as an unlevered, cash-rich clinical-stage issuer whose credit profile is driven by liquidity runway rather than leverage; the absence of funded debt and interest burden is a clear strength, but persistent operating losses and negative free cash flow mean the credit depends on disciplined cash deployment.

Analyst judgement: the indicative financial risk profile is not meaningful on leverage metrics because EBITDA and operating cash flow are negative; monitoring should focus on cash burn trajectory, pipeline milestone funding needs, and any future debt issuance or shareholder return activity that could erode the current liquidity cushion.

credit_strengths.text: Roivant 持有龐大的未受限現金結餘，遠超其流動負債，由此產生的流動比率遠高於醫療保健行業中位數，顯示有充裕的短期流動性可在無需外部融資的情況下為臨床項目提供資金。
資本結構基本上看似無槓桿，並無標記的有息債務，且報告的現金利息支出為零，因此公司並無有意義的固定費用負擔，並保留靈活性，可在管道里程碑證明合理時籌集非攤薄資本。

key_risks.text: Roivant 仍為臨床階段生物製藥公司，並無商業化階段產品，且在取得監管批准前預期不會有產品收入，因此經營虧損及現金消耗很可能遠超本財政年度仍將持續。
經營現金流出及自由現金流均為深度負值，且由於並無報告債務標記，缺乏債務到期時間表及利息支出項目，限制了對任何可能與管道資金競爭的表外或類租賃義務的可見度。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 由於報告的現金利息支出為零且並無未償還有息債務，傳統的覆蓋率及槓桿比率並不具意義；債務償付能力反而取決於龐大現金結餘相對於年度現金消耗所提供的流動性跑道。
自由現金流為負並吸收現金儲備，但流動比率及現金狀況在當前消耗速度下提供多年緩衝；研發支出的任何加速將縮短該跑道，並增加對再融資或股權融資的依賴。

overall_credit_view.text: Roivant 呈現為無槓桿、現金充裕的臨床階段發行人，其信用狀況由流動性跑道而非槓桿驅動；並無有息債務及利息負擔是一項明顯優勢，但持續經營虧損及負自由現金流意味著該信用取決於審慎的現金部署。
分析師判斷：由於 EBITDA 及經營現金流均為負值，指示性財務風險狀況在槓桿指標上並不具意義；監測應聚焦於現金消耗軌跡、管道里程碑資金需求，以及任何可能侵蝕當前流動性緩衝的未來債務發行或股東回報活動。
